name: Planning - Order planning and resource allocation
description: Verifies order planning: resource allocation, crew assignment, timeline scheduling, and planning packet generation

planSteps.description: Log in as 'residente' and navigate to /dashboard/planning
Assert that planning dashboard shows orders pending planning approval with their status
Click on an order to open its planning view with timeline, resources, and checklists tabs
Assign crew members to the order from available personnel list
Allocate equipment and tools from the inventory/resource catalog
Set the execution timeline: start/end dates, milestones, and dependencies
Complete the planning checklist and verify all required items are addressed
Submit planning for approval and verify status changes to 'pending_approval'
Approve the planning and navigate to /dashboard/planning-packet/new to generate the planning packet
